schema_origin_note: INFERRED from kr-corpus-v1 brief §3 literals + harness Stage A needs (trading_value for value_rank baseline). NOT yet contrasted against a real terminal corpus manifest. Stage B must loud-fail on any mismatch; silent coercion is forbidden.

notes.session_date: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, Asia/Seoul session date
notes.trading_value: inferred field required by BASELINE_SMOKE=value_rank_topN_D5 (거래대금); may need remap if real corpus uses a different column name — that remap must be an explicit contract revision, not silent coercion

notes.member: true iff symbol is in the investable universe for that session_date
notes.status: listed|delisted|suspended — delisted requires explicit terminal handling (silent drop forbidden)
notes.pit: universe at session t is built only from membership rows with session_date <= t; live DB universe flags are forbidden

manifest.file_sha256: hex lowercase SHA-256 of full file bytes; verified BEFORE parquet parse
